slides.text: Shiloh 2025
Unveiling the Great Mystery of Love
Matthew 13:11 Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
Ephesians 5:22-32
Ephesians 5:32 This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
The great mystery of love is being married to Jesus
Becoming a kingdom first lady, with all of heaven's immunity around your life
Mysteries are divine secrets embedded within the pages of scripture
Isaiah 55:9-11 For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts. So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth
Mysteries are wrapped up in biblical simplicity
Peculiar, untouchable, unassailable, unmolestable
Love in the kingdom is an absolutely personal affair
1 John 4:16 God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
John 14:21 He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me
1 John 3:17 How dwelleth the love of God in him?
1 John 4:18 There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
Each one's choice to love Him is what defines his place. Refuse to be lost in the crowd.
Cut a covenant of love with Jesus tonight
God's word contains mysteries, and great mysteries
2 Thessalonians 2:7 For the mystery of iniquity doth already work
1 Timothy 3:16 And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness
Romans 8:28 And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God
Exodus 7:12 For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.
Genesis 2:24 Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
The cleaving dimension of love is what equals marriage

Deuteronomy 11:22-25 If ye shall diligently keep all these commandments, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him; then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you. There shall no man be able to stand before you: for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land
When one gets to the living realm of love with Christ, he or she gets married to Him
Jesus, whatever You cannot do in my life, let it remain undone
When you get married to Jesus, you become a covering for your family
Esther 4:14 Who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
Esther 5:3 What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what is thy request? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom.
The immunity dimension of love

2 Corinthians 11:1-2 Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
Anything that takes a place before Him disqualifies you for that marriage
It all begins with a choice
Deuteronomy 30:19 I have set before you life and death: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live
Genesis 22:17 And thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies
Ephesians 5:30 For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
Somebody's unbelief cannot make your faith of no effect. Jealously guard your own stand.
A testimony of personal love for God in the day of trouble
Isaiah 38:3 Remember now, O LORD, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart
Love without proof is fake
Ephesians 5:24 So let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
2 Corinthians 8:8 To prove the sincerity of your love.
1 John 5:3 For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
Zechariah 2:8 For he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.

Isaiah 43:3-4 For I am the LORD thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee. Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
New birth is the starting point of our adventure with Christ
1 John 5:4 For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world
John 3:8 The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
2 Corinthians 5:17 If any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
Revelation 22:17 And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
